test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution: The correct answer is **"help."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The verb **'help'** means to assist or support someone in doing something. (किसी की सहायता करना) • In this sentence, we need the V1 form of the verb. • In this context, the blank requires a verb that means to support or aid. • The verb **'help' **fits this description and is the correct answer. • **Example**: *The team worked together to **help__** each other.* • So, the correct answer is Option 1. • Correct passage: The grammar concepts __are graded__ systematically and explained with examples __followed__ by exercises. The writing section __provides__ abundant practice in functional and imaginative writing with necessary scaffolding to __**help**__ learners. The listening and speaking sections have activities embedded in meaningful contexts that will encourage ______ (5) ______ to interact confidently in English. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **"Assisted"** means to help someone in doing something. (सहायता करना) • **"Discourage'** means to persuade someone not to do something. ((किसी व्‍यक्ति को) निरुत्‍साहित करना (यह समझाते हुए कि सफलता नहीं मिलेगी)) • **"Formulate"** means to create or develop a plan or idea. (कुछ करने की योजना बनाना या उसके लिए विचारों को व्‍यवस्थित करना; सूत्रित करना) 1d3:Tf88, The correct answer is **"learners."**
